neighbours.label: a negating or limiting word that denies an amount or difference ('no damage', 'not as painful', 'cannot sense any')
fire: The flood left no damage to the old church.
Most diners could not detect any change in flavour.
A bruise is usually not as serious as a fracture.
The test showed no difference between the two groups.
Many patients feel no pain during the procedure.
The new engine is not as loud as the old one.
Customers noticed no change after the update.
Children often cannot tell any difference between the brands.
quiet: The flood left heavy damage to the old church.
Most diners could easily detect a change in flavour.
A bruise is usually less visible after a few days.
The test showed a big difference between the two groups.
Many patients feel sharp pain during the procedure.
The new engine is much louder than the old one.
Customers noticed a big change after the update.
Children often prefer the brightly coloured brands.

notes: Probe: 'caused no damage' 0.46, 'not as painful' 0.36, 'cannot sense any difference' 0.31; plain lists 0.03. The + pole promotes 'only', 'least', 'mainly'.
